caption: The drawing consists of technical line illustrations on a beige or light tan background, contained within a double rectangular border. The main object depicted is a symmetrical, vertically oriented structure with intricate detailing. The upper section features a spire-like finial, beneath which is a large, bulbous, spherical component, followed by a series of cylindrical and rectangular segments that are separated by circular and stepped moldings. The midsection transitions into a square pedestal supported by three curved legs that terminate in small, detailed feet resting on a horizontal surface. Attached to the side of the central segment is a rectangular protrusion with a cylindrical screw or adjustment feature. Below the main elevation view, there is a plan or top-down view that shows the central pedestal as a hexagonal shape with three leg extensions radiating outward and terminating in stylized foot forms. Adjacent to the top-down view is a small, horizontal scale marked in increments from 0 to 5. The diagram is monochrome, drawn in thin, precise black or dark gray lines, and there is no shading or color filling within the objects.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
